facts.fact: Smart Africa's Director General says the alliance has launched a cross-border digital identity pilot between Rwanda, Ghana and Benin, so Ghana takes part in a Smart Africa programme; the interview gives no date for joining, so the published date is used.

Smart Africa's Director General says a cross-border digital identity pilot between Rwanda, Ghana and Benin has already been launched and shown to work; no date of launch is given, so the published date is used.
